name: Landing Craft, Vehicle, Personnel (LCVP)
blurb: A Hangar-only Higgins-type landing craft with a reviewable bow ramp for ship-to-shore Leyte scenes.
history: The LCVP carried troops and vehicles directly onto beaches through its bow ramp. U.S. Navy material fixes its overall length and beam; this original model keeps the upper works deliberately simple and labels their dimensions as estimates.

sources.title: Ship-to-Shore Movement, Naval History and Heritage Command
